comment: The Vessel Studio catalog. Amoebius's STUDIOS page lists these; index.html shows the same studios. Add a studio here and in index.html. Optional engineMode: an arcade mode (GameModes name) that PLAY IN ENGINE opens from the main menu in the Amoebius player, the game's own vessel; engineNote says what that run is. "shared": files every studio page loads beside it (studio-look.js = the default graphics, /vessel-studio D19); build_artifact.py publishes them.

studios.name: Squirrel
studios.kind: built vessel - studio round 2 (AI sim lab)
studios.summary: The racer on its shipped numbers, with an AI sim lab: AI Squirrels at Easy, Medium or Hard on the game's four Skim Race courses, chase/follow/free cameras, 1-4x speed and a scorecard. Six play-style types over its four element levels.
studios.engineNote: The game's own Squirrel in Skim Race, against the shipped AI (pick intensity and AI difficulty on the card).

studios.name: Stoat
studios.summary: The slinger: squeeze a trigger to lay a black-white hole pair and sling round it. Five play styles, momentum carry, a four-level course ladder, an AI sim lab that races and scores every style, and (round 15) the field trajectory: the trigger pulls a black-white hole dipole apart, and a predicted path boosts you 3x down it whenever the poles warp it.
studios.engineNote: The game's own Stoat in the Slingshot race (the round-4 orbit sling the game ships today, not the studio's dipole sling).
